title: The Cipher of Bellwether Lane
author: Noor Crane
blurb: Mara Lockridge, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has spent fifteen years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the statute expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
